subject: Request: Encryption & key management evidence for SOC 2 scoping
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@finlex.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: sig-requests@finlex.com
Date: 2028-09-03T14:28:00Z
Subject: Request: Encryption & key management evidence for SOC 2 scoping

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 scoping review we need a compact evidence package covering encryption and key management. To keep the packet focused, can you provide the following by EOD Sep 6 (one-week window acceptable):

- A short description of key custody model (KMS vs customer BYOK vs HSM) and the rotation cadence for tenant keys and master KEKs.
- A sample rotation snapshot (CSV) showing at least one full rotate/rollover operation with timestamps and key IDs (sanitize customer-identifying fields).
- HSM attestation text or vendor statement covering firmware/SEAL, operator separation, and tamper evidence.
- TLS/in-transit cipher list and confirmation that TLS termination points are included in logged traces.
- A short (1-2 paragraph) statement of how logs were sanitized and what was redacted.

If you can include a signed manifest (pdf) indicating who exported the artifacts and a checksum digest, that will speed review. We may follow up with a couple of clarifying questions once we review the files.

Best,
Lina Park
Finlex Compliance
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@finlex.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-03T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Encryption & key management evidence for SOC 2 scoping

Hi Lina —

Thanks for the clear list. We can produce a sanitized evidence bundle that meets those items. Quick plan:

1) Ben will produce the rotation snapshot CSV and operator ACL snapshot.
2) Irene will pull the HSM attestation and provide the vendor statement + note on firmware/SEAL.
3) I will assemble a signed-manifest.pdf with checksums and a brief redaction note.

One question: do you need raw TLS traces, or is a summary plus the cipher suite inventory sufficient? We prefer to provide a summarized trace with the exported TLS ciphers and a short excerpt of headers (sanitized) rather than full packet captures.

We will aim to deliver an initial package by end of day Sep 5, but can extend to Sep 6 if needed.

-Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-04T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Encryption & key management evidence for SOC 2 scoping

Thanks Steph — looping in infra ops to kick off exports. Per Lina's ask, I'll include the following artifacts in the package:

- rotation-snap-20280901.csv (columns: key_id, key_type, rotate_op, initiated_by, started_at, completed_at, prior_key_id) — sanitized tenant_id replaced with tenant_hash
- operator-acl-snapshot-20280901.json (roles and operator IDs; personally-identifying operator usernames hashed)
- signed-manifest-rotation.pdf (will include SHA256 digests for each exported file)

I propose to sanitize by hashing tenant identifiers and redacting IP addresses. If Finlex requires a stronger pseudonymization approach, flag it now.

Attaching a short export checklist for infra.

-Ben Carter
Principal, Encryption Ops
Redwood Inference

Hi team —

Exported the HSM attestation and rotation snapshot this morning. Notes:

- hsm-attestation-2028-09-04.txt is the vendor-signed attestation covering firmware checksum, SEAL status, and operator separation controls. It references the appliance serial (redacted) and includes a timestamped signature block from the HSM vendor.
- rotation-snap-20280901.csv: includes a full rotate/rollover event for the KEK used to wrap tenant keys. We replaced tenant identifiers with tenant_hash values and removed any request payloads. The CSV includes the initiation/completion timestamps and prior_key_id.
- operator-acl-snapshot-20280901.json contains role->operator mappings. We replaced operator usernames with operator_hash to preserve privacy but kept role names intact (HSM_ADMIN, KMS_OPERATOR, AUDIT_READER).

Sanitization approach: deterministic HMAC(sha256) hashing with a team secret for tenant and operator IDs; we include the method in the manifest. I uploaded the full artifact set (sanitized) to the shared Drive folder and attached local copies here as requested.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExampleLink

Attaching: hsm-attestation-2028-09-04.txt, rotation-snap-20280901.csv, operator-acl-snapshot-20280901.json, signed-manifest-rotation.pdf

—Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Cryptography & Key Management
Redwood Inference

To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Date: 2028-09-05T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Encryption & key management evidence for SOC 2 scoping

Stephanie / team —

Received the artifacts and the Drive link. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear redaction note. A couple of quick items to close the packet:

1) Can you include a short Statement of Non-repudiation (1 paragraph) in the manifest stating who exported the files and that the attached checksum list matches the exported files? We prefer a DocuSign-signed statement where feasible.
2) If possible, add the SHA256 digest for rotation-snap-20280901.csv into the manifest and provide the same digest as a detached text file (digest-rotation-20280901.txt).

If you can push those two items by EOD Sep 6 we should be good to finalize the evidence packet for our SOC 2 auditor.

Thanks again — Lina
Finlex Compliance
